channel.title: Peptides Weekly
channel.description:
What peptides are, what the evidence actually shows, and what is approved, investigational or unregulated. Every Thursday: the week in peptide science and regulation, and one peptide explained properly — mechanism, studies, status, risks. Education only; never dosing, sourcing or protocols, and never medical advice.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

item.description: Peptides Weekly Phase 3 results for an investigational amylin peptide medicine in diabetes and obesity were released this week. What You Need to Know: Novo Nordisk reported new phase 3 data on an amylin-based candidate. A pair of randomized trials found oral semaglutide did not slow progression in mild Alzheimer’s disease. ...
